description: A fenced code block tagged as the diagram language has no built-in grammar in the slide engine's highlighter; while slide mode is active such a block is wrapped in a diagram container element so a downstream diagram plugin can render it. This boundary scenario varies the diagram block body while slide mode is active. The input supplies Markdown containing a diagram fenced block; output reports whether the diagram container marker is present.

input.markdown:
---
marp: true
---

```mermaid
graph TD; A-->B; B-->C
```
